title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Veterans Memorial Coliseum on 1973-03-19
source: flac24/96 Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info:WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master Reel Transferred by Rob Eaton; All Mastering By Charlie Miller; the original version of this source had a 2 second dropout in thrack 16 (Playing In The Band)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an early‑73 show with a smoking Nobody's Fault But Mine jam after Truckin' and stellar performances of Stella Blue, He's Gone and Half‑Step.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine soundboard source that lets the band’s tight playing shine. Highlights include a sweet Nobody's Fault But Mine improv following Truckin', gorgeous renditions of Stella Blue, He’s Gone and Half‑Step, and an overall high‑energy early‑’73 vibe. Reviewers rave about both the musical fire and the crystal‑clear audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (4‑5) and enthusiastic comments on both performance and soundboard quality lead to a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the soundboard "fantastic", "crisp" and note the excellent overall mix with no reported dropouts or balance issues.

standout_songs: Truckin' > Nobody's Fault But Mine jam
show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑73 set praised for its smooth flow and a sweet "Mississippi" ride, with strong transitions and an especially memorable second half.
